rationale: The TJSP decision concerns municipal liability, land-use ordering, and regularization of an irregular subdivision (loteamento ilegal) causing environmental damage within watershed protection zones (áreas de proteção de mananciais). Under the calibrated protocol, Brazilian mananciais protection cases are classified as WATER (environmental_protection), while strict_service_access_label is UNCERTAIN because the dispute addresses land-use regularization in a manancial zone without direct water/sanitation utility service access or water abstraction/effluent adjudication.
